recipe.visualDefinition: A warm, cluttered indoor scene featuring a couple and two bulldogs seated by a roaring brick fireplace. The man wears a captain's hat and plaid shirt, while the woman wears a black sweater with rainbow stripes on the sleeves. The environment is dense with Victorian-style decor, brass kettles, and a tea service, captured with the soft grain and warm saturation of 1970s film.
coreVisualRelationships: The diagonal line formed by the woman leaning against the man's leg.
The warm glow of the fire contrasting with the deep red of the velvet sofa.
The repetition of circular shapes in the tea tray, plates, and bulldog faces.
The balance between the dark, cluttered left side and the bright, active fire on the right.
coreInvariants: A brick fireplace with an active flame on the right third.
A man in a nautical cap and a woman in a rainbow-accented sweater.
At least one English Bulldog present in the foreground.
A dark brown header bar containing white serif typography.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are centered-left, occupying the middle ground at a medium-full shot scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright orange-yellow fire on the right provides the primary light source and visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the fire, moves left across the subjects, down to the tea service, and up to the header text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is packed with objects, textures, and patterns to create a sense of domestic abundance.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and deep reds from the brick, wood, and velvet sofa.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright orange and yellow from the fire.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Rainbow stripes (red, yellow, green, blue) on the woman's sleeve.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the warm tones with deep, crushed shadows typical of vintage film stocks.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid cool blues except as small accents
Maintain a warm, amber-tinted white balance

characterSpecificRedesigns: The ampersand is stylized and slightly smaller than the surrounding caps.

composition.relationshipToImage: Contained within a solid dark brown border
Contained within a solid dark brown border

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold upright serif for the name paired with a lighter, elegant italic serif for the title.
graphicDevices: Solid dark brown horizontal header bar at the top edge.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the elegant, traditional feel of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A 1970s style color photograph of a couple sitting on a red velvet sofa in a cluttered, cozy living room. A man in a plaid shirt and captain's hat sits next to a woman in a black sweater with rainbow stripes. Two bulldogs are resting near them. To the right is a large brick fireplace with a bright fire. The top of the image should have a solid dark brown horizontal bar.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add white serif text to the top brown bar. On the left, place the main name in bold all-caps serif. On the right, place the title in a medium-weight italic serif.

verificationChecks: Is there a dark brown bar at the top?
Are the subjects wearing the specific 70s attire described?
Is the lighting dominated by the fireplace glow?

adjustableVariables: Specific colors of the rainbow stripes
Thickness of the top header bar
mustRedesign: Any brand logos on the clothing or objects
The specific A&M records logo in the corner

mustAchieve: Clear typographic hierarchy in the header

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the bulldogs look like English Bulldogs.
Check that the rainbow stripes are only on the sleeves.
Verify the text is white and contained within the brown bar.
Confirm the fireplace is on the right side of the frame.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a 1970s domestic interior photograph with a solid-color header bar containing high-contrast serif typography for a classic album aesthetic.
